generation_steps_sentinelone: Sign in to SentinelOne Management Console with Admin credentials.
Click Actions dropdown and select 'Create New Service User'.
Enter information for the new service user, set Role to 'Admin'.
Log in to SentinelOne Management Console with the new service user's credentials.
Select the newly added service user.
Copy or download this API Token.

sumo_logic_source_configuration.prerequisite: Identify or create a Hosted Collector.
steps: In Sumo Logic UI (Classic: Manage Data > Collection > Collection; New: Configuration > Data Collection > Collection), navigate to the Collectors page.
Click 'Add Source' next to a Hosted Collector.
Search for and select 'SentinelOne Mgmt API'.
(Optional) Check 'Forward to SIEM' if Cloud SIEM is installed.
Select one or more 'Supported APIs to collect': activities, agents, and/or threats.
sumo_logic_source_configuration.configuration_via_json: Sources can be configured using UTF-8 encoded JSON files with the Collector Management API. Parameters include 'schemaRef', 'sourceType', and a 'config' object containing 'name', 'description', 'category', 'fields', 'base_url', 'api_secret', and 'supported_apis'.
